notes: Inbound via signup form: interested in hosted API (self-serve), low-friction integration into existing LMS.
Primary contact: Mia Torres (CTO, <mia@classbridge.io>) — small engineering team, wants to ship an in-class assistant for teachers.
Use cases described on call: 1) Classroom copilot (lesson summarization, question generation), 2) real-time content moderation for student chat, 3) student helpdesk bot for homework FAQs.
Latency/throughput: <200ms p95 desired for chat UI, but willing to accept ~300-400ms initially; peak concurrent users ~150-250 messages/min.
Cost sensitivity: high — monthly budget ~$1k-$3k to start. Interested in cost-optimization suggestions (quantization, batching).
Model preferences: open models ok (Llama 2-70B too costly), prefer small-medium open models or Redwood-verified efficient variants. Value preset 'education' safety filters.
Security/compliance: SSO for admin console (SAML ok), audit logs required for teacher actions, retention controls to drop student data after 30 days. No on-prem or VPC at this time.
Quoted: 'We can't exceed $3k/month in year 1 — need a predictable bill.'
Requested artifacts: pricing deck, quickstart guide, moderation accuracy metrics, sample eval prompt set.
AE notes: demo should focus on low-cost model profiles + built-in moderation and streaming for teacher UI. Offer 1-month free credits + 2-week POC.
Next meeting: 2026-03-04 10:00 PT — technical demo w/ eng lead (Jordan to present).
